claim_assessments.statement: For a projective klt Q-pair over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, with K_X+B pseudo-effective, M nef Q-Cartier on X, and D=K_X+B+M nef, there is a semiample Q-Cartier L on X with D numerically equivalent to L.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Faithful numerical conclusion on the original variety; not actual semiampleness of D or a theorem for arbitrary higher-model nef data.

claim_assessments.statement: The terminal Calabi-Yau full-nef-dimension bigness step follows from scalar bounds, large projective-bundle jets and construction of the finite-data inputs.
claim_assessments.fidelity: The terminal theorem assumes complex projective Q-factorial terminal X, dimension n>=2, K_X linearly trivial, nef Cartier L of full nef dimension, and lower-dimensional P_j; its extension to klt Calabi-Yau pairs uses further abundance and model inputs.

claim_assessments.statement: Scalar moving-jet bounds, bounded-degree exclusions, large Seshadri estimates and movable-curve construction supply all finite-data inputs.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Faithful dependency list only when ordinary-power containments, general-incidence restrictions, uniform constants, fixed-data order of choices and the entire movable-curve/flag interface are retained.

claim_assessments.statement: Companion ordinary log abundance as cited by the family is not an independently established campaign input.
claim_assessments.fidelity: Pinned projective preliminaries cite Theorem 1.1: a nef ordinary lc rational adjoint is semiample in characteristic zero. The old report's separate Theorem 9.1 target attribution does not identify or prove this input.

supported_scope: Exact theorem fidelity, hypotheses, quantifiers, attribution and dependency mapping for the four version-1 claims.
Source contains conditional reductions and proof passages; the old catalogue does not independently discharge their geometric or birational obligations.
Finite-data v7 is referenced only as the conditional dependency assigned by the current coverage index, not re-proved or used to certify construction of its inputs.
Historical reviewer support concerns algebraic/finite-data units; none supports these assigned claims or establishes current family acceptance.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Establish simultaneous P_n/Z_n, the compatible ordinary and generalized MMPs, preservation of the generated ordinary line, numerical nef descent, a relative good model and effective ordinary base adjoint, followed by Picard and field descent.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: A conditional Frobenius incompatibility certificate neither constructs these models nor proves the cited abundance, relative finite-generation or descent inputs.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Prove full-nef-dimension bigness with terminal, Cartier and lower-dimensional induction hypotheses, and transport it through the index-one cover, terminalization and effective klt boundary perturbation.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Finite-data incompatibility is conditional on assembled data; it does not prove every nef divisor is big or perform the Calabi-Yau reductions.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Construct full moving jet kernels and ordinary-power base-ideal containments, prove uniform bounded-degree exclusions for slices and correspondences, exclude sweeping branch divisors and obtain fixed branch complements, then establish the large Seshadri estimate.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: Old algebraic rank/determinant evidence has no moving incidence family, branch complement, birational abelian model or universal scalar-jet estimate.

concrete_gaps.obligation: After fixing epsilon, the gap, q and one small t, jointly realize the smooth divisor/intersection data, high jets, flag conditions, scalar quantifiers and a movable curve with the required normalized intersections and cotangent/slope bounds.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: The decisive permitted source handoff fixes t and delegates assembly to the next section; the catalogue exhibits no joint tuple. The excluded Frobenius proof is owned by the separate geometric assessment.

concrete_gaps.obligation: Supply the cited ordinary lc log-abundance theorem when making ordinary nef endpoints semiample and when replacing a klt Calabi-Yau numerical adjoint by a rationally trivial one.
concrete_gaps.old_evidence_limit: The companion is unlisted as an accessible source manuscript here and remains an unverified cited dependency, not an accepted theorem.
